entities.summary: Erel N. Margalit is an Israeli venture capitalist and social entrepreneur. He is the founder and Executive Chairman of the global venture capital firm Jerusalem Venture Partners (JVP) and Margalit StartUp City. He is also the founder of two non-profit organizations Bakehila and Israel Initiative 2020, which has established seven regions of excellence that combine technology and education.
